title: RequestContext
description: Domain context captured when an operation originates a resource. Persisted resources retain this origin context; it is not rewritten to identify a later HTTP polling attempt. Current HTTP attempt identity is carried by the required Game API headers X-Request-Id, X-Trace-Id, X-Correlation-Id, and X-Schema-Version.
x-invariants: persisted resource request_context is immutable origin context
current HTTP attempt identity is transported separately and never overwrites origin context

wireAttemptContext.title: WireAttemptContext
wireAttemptContext.description: Transport-only identity available before authentication/bootstrap resolves actor and content context.
